title: AtomMem — where the paper and the code part ways
subtitle: Only the divergent steps are drawn. Each node states both sides; the lane says which stage of the pipeline the divergence sits in.
source: paper arXiv:2606.19847  ×  repo AtomMem @ 776f880   ·   servers/atommem/verification.md §5, 16 divergences found, 14 drawn here
footer: memory-bench · methodology flow · paper ↔ code divergence
legend_notes: Headline: AtomMem's namesake contribution — the Fact Executor — is the model that never runs in this repo's benchmarked LoCoMo pipeline. No weights, no training code; facts are read pre-extracted from disk (D1).

Second-biggest gap: event_contexts is computed at query time and then explicitly discarded before the final prompt is built, despite two prompt figures and the running text naming it as an input (D5).

A3 ADMIT is where the paper's single joint LLM call (residual + conflict) splits into three independent code paths: threshold dedup, LLM conflict-with-hard-overwrite, and an unrelated second retrieval for event attribution (D2, D3).

Not drawn: D12 (no CLI switch for the paper's ablation variants) and D14 (README env-var typo, ATOMMEM_FACT_EXECUTOR_* vs the code's ATOMMEM_FACT_EXTRACTOR_*) — both are real findings in verification.md §5 but neither is a pipeline step that fits a stage lane.
